SAS Information Governance
Data democratization. Enhanced collaboration. Regulatory compliance.
Employ enterprise-grade data & AI governance
Regardless of the source or where the data resides, enable users to find, catalog and protect data that is most valuable for analysis. Create a shared understanding of data using a business glossary. Integrate with broader governance initiatives using the Open Metadata Standard.
Discover information assets with ease
Find data, reports, models and other analytics assets using Google-like keyword search. Tag sensitive data for compliance. With a user-friendly data catalog, teams can quickly access and evaluate asset fitness, avoid rework and make informed choices in a secure and governed environment.
Evaluate data fitness
Ensure the usability of data sets with data profiling. Assess data health, evaluate column-level data quality metrics, and view semantic types for columns using advanced data classification. Identify sensitive personal data (such as PII) with an embedded information privacy assessment.
Analyze impact with data lineage
Get a bird’s eye view on assets, sources and outputs, along with their relationships. Track the data movement through the data pipeline and identify affected assets from source to destination. Respond confidently to regulatory requirements by providing visibility across the analytics life cycle.
